newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Anscor 1996 net up at 463 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Anscor 1996 net up at 463 mln pesos.

text.p: A. Soriano Corp, the holding company of the Soriano family, reported on Monday its net income in 1996 reached 463 million pesos, up from the 1995 figure of 307 million pesos.
The company said 1996 earnings were primarily driven by higher earnings from equity investments even though group revenues in 1996 were lower.
Equity earnings jumped to 515 million pesos in 1996 from 58 million pesos in 1995. The income came from its core investments in port management, wire and cable manufacturing and financial services.

The company also generated a trading gain of 233 million pesos from marketable securities and from the sale of its shares in Atlas Fertlizer Corp to HLG Capital, a unit of the Hong Leong group of Malaysia.

Anscor said its group revenues in 1996 fell by 12 percent to 3.2 billion pesos due to the decrease in net sales of Phelps Dodge Philippines (PDP), a wire and cable manufacturer which is 59 percent-owned by Anscor.

Phelps Dodge registered lower revenues of 2.3 billion pesos in 1996 from 2.7 billion pesos in 1995 as it realigned its product mix to concentrate on high-margin products such as communication cables and building wires, Anscor said.
This strategy resulted in a higher net income for Phelps Dodge, Anscor said.
